LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USES 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you show the number of things you have?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify plurals of regular and irregular nouns for effective communication
2. use plurals of regular and irregular nouns in spoken and written language for communication clarity

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USES 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify plurals of regular and irregular nouns for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use plurals of regular and irregular nouns in spoken and written language for communication clarity
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you show the number of things you have?
2. Which things do we have in our classroom?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify plurals of regular and irregular nouns for effective communication
2. use plurals of regular and irregular nouns in spoken and written language for communication clarity
